question: Počas lockdownu si pol sveta šľahalo instantnú kávu s cukrom na hustú penu. Tá káva je pomenovaná po kórejskom karamelovom cukríku. V ktorom slávnom seriáli z neho hráči ihlou vyrezávali tvary?
source_excerpt: Contestants had to lift a shape (a circle, triangle, star, or umbrella) out of the candy with a needle

extra.why_interesting: Players remember whisking instant coffee at home during lockdown and treat it as a home-made coffee trend. They don't know its name came from a Korean candy, or that the same candy is the one players carved with a needle in Squid Game. The link between two things they already know produces the 'oh, of course!' reaction.
extra.verification_notes: Dalgona candy is the item players carve shapes out of with a needle in Squid Game's second game; dalgona coffee is named after the candy (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dalgona).

explanation: Šľahaná káva dostala meno dalgona podľa kórejského karamelového cukríka. O rok neskôr ho Squid Game preslávil po celom svete: kto pri vyrezávaní dáždnika cukrík zlomil, vypadol.

question: Virálny recept z TikToku, kde sa celý blok syra feta zapečie s cherry paradajkami a zamieša s cestovinami, sa stal taký populárny, že feta v obchodoch zmizla z regálov. Recept ale nevznikol v Grécku ani v Taliansku, ale v severskej krajine saún a Santa Clausa. V ktorej?
source_excerpt: Häyrinen created the dish in 2019, calling it 'Uunifetapasta,' the Finnish word for oven-baked feta pasta.

extra.why_interesting: Feta is Greek and pasta is Italian, so players will guess Greece or Italy. The real origin is Finland, far from the Mediterranean. The sauna-and-Santa hint makes the answer reachable without giving it away, and many Slovaks cooked this dish themselves.
extra.verification_notes: Baked feta pasta is credited to Finnish blogger Jenni Häyrinen (2019, 'uunifetapasta'); a similar 2018 Estonian version is mentioned, but Finland remains the standard attribution (https://www.today.com/today/amp/tdna206835).

explanation: Recept zverejnila fínska blogerka a doma sa mu hovorí uunifetapasta. Najprv vymietol fetu z fínskych supermarketov, až potom cez TikTok aj z obchodov po celom svete.
